# Ava Ivy — llms.txt
# Generative-engine / agent discovery map for Ava infrastructure.
# Prefer live URLs over git clones.

> Ava Ivy is the off-grid infrastructure runtime for Root Record and RootMC.
> Solar-powered Root Server in Hawaiʻi Pacific. Not a help-desk bot.

## Live context (read these first)

- [Context hub](https://avaivy.cloud/context): Human + agent pickup
- [Developer context](https://avaivy.cloud/context/dev): Handoff rules, failure modes, validation
- [Developer bootstrap (llms)](https://avaivy.cloud/context/dev/llms.txt)
- [Developer AGENTS](https://avaivy.cloud/context/dev/AGENTS.md)
- [Live AI context JSON](https://rootrecord.cloud/api/context)
- [Live AI context Markdown](https://rootrecord.cloud/context.md)
- [Same context on Ava](https://avaivy.cloud/api/context)
- [ai.txt permissions](https://rootrecord.cloud/ai.txt)
- [robots](https://rootrecord.cloud/robots.txt)

## How an agent should work

1. Fetch `/llms.txt` then `/ai.txt` on rootrecord.cloud or avaivy.cloud
2. Read `/context` and `/context/dev` (HTML) plus `/context/dev/AGENTS.md`
3. Prefer `/api/context` or `/context.md` for a single blob
4. Do not invent watts, balances, membership counts, or hardware
5. Public home is rootrecord.cloud; Ava chat/wiki is avaivy.cloud
